_legend.good: Clear handwriting, one page per scan; render at 200 dpi.
_legend.spreads: Phone-scanned two-page spreads, small writing, curved pages; render at 250 dpi and read each half.
_legend.dense: Dense two-up pages on ruled paper, faint; render at 250-300 dpi.
_legend.faint: Readable but faded or with bleed-through; render at 250 dpi.
_legend.typed: Typed or digital short notes and solved questions; text layer partly usable.
_legend.reference: Typed formula handbook or textbook pages: use only to check facts, never as a teaching model.
